params.name: board
params.description: Board directory short name (e.g. `a`, `b`, `g`, `pol`, `po`, `v`). The full list of valid values is the `board` field on each entry in `/boards.json`.

items.docs: Returns the full catalog snapshot for the given board: every OP with its attributes and a short list of preview replies, grouped by index page. This is the largest per-board document and mirrors the public catalog page at `boards.4channel.org/{board}/catalog`.
